analysis: The host reported a timeout after 338.02 allocated GPU-seconds, with no validation score and no error text. The available result does not identify the execution stage or timeout cause. DropEdge's effect on HR@10 is therefore unmeasured; neither improvement nor regression can be claimed. The code adds sparse graph reconstruction and extensive diagnostics, but their contribution to runtime is unverified. Category deadlines are checked only after an entire training epoch, so they do not bound preparation, diagnostics, or individual epochs.
code_summary: One independently trained graph recommender per category, with exactly one selected checkpoint loaded for prediction. The network combines LightGCN propagation, learned node-specific depth attention, causal convolution over histories, recency embeddings, candidate-conditioned history attention, gated user/history fusion, and tied item vectors with learned biases. Training uses sampled-softmax loss and embedding regularization. The experimental change applies training-only DropEdge after supervised-pair masking: retain each unique user–item edge with probability 0.9, preserve both directions together, recompute symmetric degree normalization, and share the sampled graph across propagation layers. Inference uses the full training graph. Metadata and predictor checks encode the DropEdge architecture; RNG-preserving diagnostics cover graph integrity, isolated nodes, deterministic evaluation, gradients, and checkpoint reload parity. No ensembles or checkpoint averaging are used.
